objectives.text: Find the _ingredient_ hidden away in ___dungeon_
Bring the _ingredient_ to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_ for the finder's fee

outcomes.text: The student has the _ingredient_, though not as fresh as _qgiver_ would have liked.
The _ingredient_ never reached the Guild.

objectives.text: Take fresh wrappings off the mummy =mummy_ in ___mondung_
Bring the wrappings to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: _qgiver_ has superlatively fresh mummy wrappings for the potion.
The wrappings never reached _qgiver_.

objectives.text: Cast Sleep on _warrior_ at _castle_ in __castle_, and no other spell
Return to _qgiver_ at the Mages Guild of ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: _warrior_ dropped into a deep sleep on the spot, and the Guild kept a friend.
_warrior_ is still awake, and still cursed.

objectives.text: Collect the research from _scholar_ at __scholar_ in ___scholar_. Beware the Necromancers.
Hear what _db_ of the Dark Brotherhood offers for the research at __db_ in ___db_
Bring _scholar_'s research back to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: _db_ of the Dark Brotherhood asks for _scholar_'s research.

choices.text: Give the research to the Dark Brotherhood

outcomes.text: The Brotherhood paid for the research, and the Guild paid for the forgery you brought it.
You sold _scholar_'s research to the Dark Brotherhood, and the Guild got nothing.
You took the Brotherhood's gold and its forgery, and never went back to the Guild.
You refused the Dark Brotherhood to its face and brought the research home.
_scholar_'s research is safe in the Guild's hands.
_scholar_'s research never reached the Guild.

objectives.text: Open _merchant_'s old chest at _shop_ in __shop_. Only the standard Open spell will work.
Give the opened chest back to _merchant_
Return to _questgiver_ at the Mages Guild of ___questgiver_

outcomes.text: _mage_'s trick box is open, and the Guild has a little good publicity.
_merchant_'s trick box stayed shut.

objectives.text: Look for the old catalog of _maker_'s works in ___hintdung_
Ask _scholar_, the expert on _maker_, about the _item_ in ___scholardung_
Fetch _scholar_'s supplies from _contact_ of __contact_ in ___contact_ and bring them back
Find _maker_'s _item_ in ___itemdung_
Report your findings to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

branches.text: _scholar_ knows nothing of the _item_, but asks you to fetch supplies from _contact_.

outcomes.text: _maker_'s _item_ is yours, and _scholar_ has the _ingredient_ you fetched besides.
_questgiver_ no longer needed _maker_'s _item_, and let you keep it.
The _item_ was never found, but _scholar_ has the _ingredient_ and _questgiver_ paid for the search.
The _item_ was never found. _questgiver_ paid for your trouble all the same.
_questgiver_ never heard what became of the search.

objectives.text: Put down the escaped atronach that has laired in ___mondung_
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ for your gold

outcomes.text: The atronach is dead, and the Guild's embarrassment with it.
The atronach still lives, and the Guild's lab security is the talk of the town.

objectives.text: Guard the _treasure_ at the Mages Guild of ___qgiver_ between midnight and three
Fight off the thieves who come for the _treasure_
Once your watch ends at three, report to _qgiver_ for the _potion_
Keep the stolen _treasure_ out of the Guild's hands while its knights hunt you

outcomes.text: The thieves didn't stand a chance, and the _treasure_ is safe.
You kept the _treasure_ you were set to guard, and the Guild's knights never took it back.
The _treasure_ went unguarded.

objectives.text: Find the rebel mage _rebel_ at _rebelhouse_ in ___rebelhouse_
Destroy _rebel_. He will not stand still to be killed.
Give _rebel_'s letter to _questgiver_ and say you found no sign of him
Report _rebel_'s death to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

branches.text: _rebel_ asks why you kill on the Guild's command, and bids you join him instead.

choices.text: Spare him and carry his letter home

outcomes.text: You let _rebel_ go and carried his letter home. _questgiver_ thinks he slipped away.
_rebel_ is dead, and the Guild's rules stand.
_questgiver_ never heard what became of _rebel_.

objectives.text: Guard _sleepingmage_ in the _magesguild_ through the three hours of the trance
Stop the assassins sent to kill _sleepingmage_
Survive the bounty hunters the Guild sends after you

outcomes.text: The assassins are dead, and _sleepingmage_ passed safely into the Aetherius.
You killed _sleepingmage_, and the Guild named you an oath-breaker.
_sleepingmage_ disappeared, and you were meant to be guarding him.

objectives.text: Slay the mad wizard _wizard_ in the laboratory at ___mondung_
Bring word of the deed to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

outcomes.text: The Mad Wizard of ___mondung_ is dead, by order of the Archmagister.
The mad wizard moved on, and nowhere is safe.

objectives.text: Meet the Acolyte at _temple_ in __temple_, as his letter asks
See that _noble_ of _noblehouse_ in __noblehouse_ goes into hiding before the prophecy comes true
Find the Oracle in __oracletemple_ and escort her to _noble_
Free _love_ from the kidnappers in ___mondung_, then return to _noble_

branches.text: Who will talk _noble_ into hiding: the Oracle, or the love _noble_ will not abandon?

choices.text: Bring the Oracle to plead with _noble_

outcomes.text: The Oracle talked _noble_ into hiding, and will commend you to the court of Sentinel.
_love_ is free, and _noble_ has gone into hiding with the most trusted guards.
The hour came, and the wind whispers that _noble_ is dead.

objectives.text: Destroy the spell-soaked imp that has taken over _palace_ of __palace_
Return to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_ for your gold

outcomes.text: The imp that thought itself fit to rule is dead, and __palace_ is spared.
The imp still rules _palace_, and __palace_ suffers for it.

objectives.text: Draw blood from =daedra_ in ___mondung_, then read _qgiver_'s scroll to bind it
Cast the standard Banish Daedra on =daedra_. _qgiver_ wants it banished, not slain.
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

branches.text: _qgiver_ wants back the scroll with =daedra_'s true name, to call it again.

choices.text: Burn it, and the daedra stays in Oblivion

outcomes.text: =daedra_ is banished, and _qgiver_ has its true name for next time.
=daedra_ is banished, and its true name is ash.
You killed =daedra_ instead of banishing it, and _qgiver_ showed you the door.
=daedra_ still vexes ___mondung_.

objectives.text: Ask around ___giver_ after the stolen _book_. The taverns hear everything.
Find _thief_ and take back the _book_
Bring the _book_ back to _giver_

outcomes.text: _book_ is back on the Guild's shelves, and _giver_ owes you a good word.
The Guild's rare edition of _book_ is lost for good.

objectives.text: Find the _ingredient_ hidden away in ___dungeon_
Bring the _ingredient_ to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The _ingredient_ is delivered, and the Guild gave you a map to ___newdung_ besides.
The _ingredient_ is delivered, and _qgiver_ will speak well of you in the guild halls.
_qgiver_ never got the _ingredient_.

objectives.text: Kill the student's escaped pet imp in ___mondung_
Report back to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_

outcomes.text: The imp is dead, and the student's embarrassment stays a secret.
The imp got away, and the Guild's lab security is the talk of the town.

objectives.text: Find the ancient text hidden in ___dungeon_
Bring the text to _questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

outcomes.text: _questgiver_ has the ancient text, and will spread the word that you are the Guild's kind.
The ancient text was never brought back.
